changelog: Dev build v844 - Fixed: Tap to TV could report success while nothing opened on the receiving device. CSM-to-CSM delivery opens the media through CloudStream's own player link (cloudstreamplayer://<enc>?name=<enc>, the shape the host manifest documents), but the receiver started that intent and then answered OK unconditionally, so the sender showed a success message even when nothing on the device handled the link and no player ever appeared. The receiver now resolves the link first and refuses with a clear reason instead of claiming playback, launches from the resumed activity when one exists so the start is a foreground start (a background context may be ignored by the platform), reports a refusal instead of a false OK, and words a background start as sent rather than started. Tests: 5 new launch-contract tests (deep-link shape, intent target, no-handler cannot be reported as playing, resolution detected, wording never claims verified playback). This dev build aggregates all current unpublished source in the shared CSM tree.
message: Dev build v844 - Tap to TV receiver no longer reports playback it never started
